reason: Free sounds nice, but I've never heard of Mitra and I'm not pasting my brand deals and DMs into some random app. I already sort my collabs on WhatsApp and Instagram, and I can mostly smell a scam myself.
objection: Who is behind this and what do they do with my deal screenshots, my rates and my number? If a 'free forever' app has my deal details, I'm the product until proven otherwise.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I actually know in Bengaluru telling me they got a real paid café or salon deal through it, with the fee paid on time.
